entities.summary: Robin de Kruijf  is a Dutch volleyball player who plays for Imoco Volley and the Netherlands national team. Robin de Kruijf made her debut for the Dutch national team in the Dutch opening match of the Montreux Volley Masters against Cuba in June 2008, at the age of 17. In 2016, De Kruijf and her team won bronze in the World Grand Prix and ended on a historical fourth place in the Rio Olympics.
